2 15-05-2024 We have heard Mr. Ajay Kumar Chakraborty, the learned Advocate for the appellant.

2. This appeal is against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 07.11.2023 /
09.11.2023 passed in POCSO Case No. 16 of 2021 arising out of Dhansoi P.S. Case No. 07 of 2021 by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge- VI-cum- Special Court POCSO Act, Buxar,
whereby the appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 363, 366A and 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of Patna High Court CR.
